_note: verify.search golden set, recorded live 2026-09-15 and replayed from fixtures/http. known_good: the 15 proposals of the mmr-vaccine-autism scratch discovery run that the registries resolved (identifier from the registry, never the model). known_bad: the PriorixTetra near-miss -- a Cochrane review title word-matching a GSK MMRV trial at ratio 0.8 -- in every form the model produced it. The trial-registry rule (search.TRIAL_MATCH_RATIO / TRIAL_MATCH_MIN) is pinned here so it cannot loosen quietly; the near-miss title pair and its ratio are recorded so a change to the tokeniser that moves the ratio is visible too. known_good also carries four compound-surname controls (particled, two-particle, hyphenated, lower-case particle): before 2026-09-15 the first token of Europe PMC's author string was read as the family name and every such author was UNRESOLVED; the mmr scratch set lost none to this because the model had attributed those papers to the wrong single-word author, which the check refuses correctly.

trial_rule.ctgov_consulted_for: kind == 'trial' only; never a fallback for an article
